name: Kohaku
source: The older of the two twin maids in the Toono mansion, Kohaku, along with her sister Hisui, is a childhood friend of Shiki. She wears a Japanese kimono and always seems to be smiling and cheerful. She was trained in brewing herbal remedies and poisons, being especially gifted with medicine.
translation: The older of the two twin maids in the Toono mansion, Kohaku, along with her sister Hisui, is a childhood friend of Shiki. She wears a Japanese kimono and always seems to be smiling and cheerful. She was trained in brewing herbal remedies and poisons, being especially gifted with medicine.
